writer.short_answer: Mid-sized Nigerian food creators work in market-run vlogs, budget meal series and regional dish explainers, and their comment sections ask for prices and recipes.

claims.text: Four mid-sized food creators lead the list in what was collected: @mama_put_kitchen, @budget_jollof_ben and @northern_flavours_zee on TikTok and @ibadan_pot_diaries on Instagram.
claims.label: corroborated

claims.text: They use three formats: market-run vlogs, budget meal series and regional dish explainers.
claims.label: corroborated

quotes.text: I will show you every stall

claims.text: Their comment sections ask for full price lists and recipes, argue about whether stall prices hold in other areas, and trade regional variations.
claims.label: inferred

claims.text: Their audience is mostly young adults.
claims.label: inferred

so_what.text: A brand can sponsor a market run, where the price list is the content, and avoid scripted taste tests.

gaps.what: This list is what was collected, not a census of Nigerian food creators
gaps.searched: stored posts and live TikTok and Instagram search
gaps.why: collection covers the creators the searches reached

headline_rewrite: Mid-sized Nigerian food creators use market-run vlogs, budget meal series and regional dish explainers, and their comments ask for prices and recipes.
